author: Emma Humphries
content: Dancing Cubs offers an excellent range of products with fantastic customer service. Delivery and installation at our party venue was on time and staff were very friendly and helpful. We had the kiddi cars and race track-it kept 20+ 3 and 4 year olds engaged and entertained for 2 hours with not a single tantrum. Even the older children (7-11yos) loved it. Fantastic and will definitely be using again.
